headline: Keep Open Graph (OG) coverage fresh during closeout

items.title: Keep Open Graph (OG) coverage fresh during closeout
items.insight: The native proof-surface gate requires OG coverage no older than2days, but the full and scheduled refresh build profiles omit its existing inventory generator. The live source run rejected a3day-old receipt.
items.evidence: Both canonical profiles declare the actual inventory producer before public status and candidate sealing; existing profile/default-invocation and OG coverage self-tests pass; actual native generation then --check passes with real page counts and unchanged2day limit. Full pipeline must execute and verify current output before release.
